On this page

Use the OpenAI group to work with the models available to your OpenAI account. The activities call the OpenAI REST API and return its response to the workflow.

## Available activities [​](https://docs.koodisi.com/working-with-activities/list-of-available-activities/openai/\#available-activities "Direct link to Available activities")

| Activity | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [**List Models**](https://docs.koodisi.com/working-with-activities/list-of-available-activities/openai/listmodels/) | Returns the models available to the account |
| [**Retrieve Model**](https://docs.koodisi.com/working-with-activities/list-of-available-activities/openai/retrievemodel/) | Returns details of a single model |
| [**Delete Model**](https://docs.koodisi.com/working-with-activities/list-of-available-activities/openai/deletemodel/) | Deletes a fine-tuned model |

## Configure an OpenAI call [​](https://docs.koodisi.com/working-with-activities/list-of-available-activities/openai/\#configure-an-openai-call "Direct link to Configure an OpenAI call")

1. Add the activity to the workflow.
2. Supply the OpenAI API key as an `Authorization` header on the **Headers** tab.
3. For **Retrieve Model** and **Delete Model**, enter the **Model Name**.
4. Map the request on the **Input** tab and the response on the **Output** tab.

These activities build on the [REST Client](https://docs.koodisi.com/working-with-activities/list-of-available-activities/http/restclient/), so their Input and Output are the generic HTTP request and response rather than an OpenAI-shaped payload.

## Recommended practices [​](https://docs.koodisi.com/working-with-activities/list-of-available-activities/openai/\#recommended-practices "Direct link to Recommended practices")

- Store the API key in a vault-backed variable rather than as literal text in a header.
- Deleting a model cannot be undone; only fine-tuned models the account owns can be deleted.
